rationale: The stock gapped up, failed immediately (open = high of day), and has ground below VWAP to pin on the $13.54 low-of-day shelf on 12.6x relative volume — a bearish intraday structure that would favor a short on a break of that shelf. However, the last two 1-minute bars show escalating volume (85k, then 111k shares) absorbed without violating 13.54 and closing at bar highs, indicating active buyers defending the low, so shorting directly into that absorption is poor timing and there is no confirmed trigger in either direction. With price wedged in a 6-cent band between the shelf and $13.60 VWAP, 5m ATR of only ~7bps offering no stop room, and 12.6x volume with no identifiable news catalyst, the coil needs to resolve before an entry with acceptable risk/reward exists.
